appearance_facts.fact: x-axis has six tick labels: 'Nuclear generation', 'Radiation management', 'Nuclear power plant construction', 'Service', 'Front end of fuel cycle', 'Spent nuclear fuel reprocessing and secondary fuel'.

Blue line connects data points for 2011. Data points are marked with solid circles. Values are: 53 (at 'Nuclear power plant construction'), 31 (at 'Nuclear power plant construction'), 17 (at 'Front end of fuel cycle'), and 26 (at 'Spent nuclear fuel reprocessing and secondary fuel').

Red line connects data points for 2030. Data points are marked with solid squares. Values are: 53 (at 'Nuclear power plant construction'), 31 (at 'Nuclear power plant construction'), 17 (at 'Front end of fuel cycle'), and 26 (at 'Spent nuclear fuel reprocessing and secondary fuel').
The blue line has a data point at 'Service' with a value of 17.

public_definitions: Review the nuclear infrastructure planning dashboard and determine which Service year entry, 2011 or 2030, should be escalated into the higher-cost follow-up queue.
